entries.subcategory: Land Selection / Land Shape (भूमि के प्रकार)
entries.description: Land that is elevated in the south, west, south-west (नैऋत्य) and north-west (वायव्य), and low in the north-east (ईशान), is called Gaj Prishtha Bhumi.
entries.recommendation: Considered favorable for construction; this land type is recommended for the site owner.
entries.expected_effect: Gives the house owner wealth (धन), longevity (आयु) and profit/gain (लाभ).
entries.section: भूमि का चयन / भूमि के लक्षण
entries.source_text: जो भूमि दक्षिण, पश्चिम, नैऋत्य तथा वायव्य दिशा में ऊंची हो तथा ईशान में नीची हो तो उसे गजपृष्ठ भूमि कहते हैं। यह भूमि गृह स्वामी को धन, आयु तथा लाभ देती है।

entries.subcategory: Land Selection / Land Shape (भूमि के प्रकार)
entries.description: Land that is elevated in the middle and low on all four sides is called Kurma Prishtha Bhumi.
entries.recommendation: Favorable for construction.
entries.expected_effect: Constructing on this land brings daily enthusiasm (उत्साह), happiness (सुख) and abundance of wealth/grain (धन धान्य की विपुलता) to the household.
entries.section: भूमि का चयन / भूमि के लक्षण
entries.source_text: यह भूमि मध्य में ऊंची तथा चारों ओर नीची होती है। ऐसी भूमि पर वास्तु निर्माण करने से प्रतिदिन घर में उत्साह, सुख तथा धन धान्य की विपुलता होती है।

entries.subcategory: Land Selection / Land Shape (भूमि के प्रकार)
entries.description: Land that is elevated in the east, south-east (आग्नेय) and north-east (ईशान), and low in the west, is called Daitya Prishtha Bhumi.
entries.recommendation: Not recommended for construction without correction.
entries.expected_effect: Construction on this land causes loss of wealth, water problems, and loss of family peace and happiness.
entries.section: भूमि का चयन / भूमि के लक्षण
entries.source_text: पूर्व, आग्नेय तथा ईशान दिशा में ऊंची तथा पश्चिम दिशा में नीची होती है, वह भूमि दैत्य पृष्ठ भूमि कही जाती है। ऐसी भूमि पर वास्तु निर्माण से धन, जल तथा परिवार की सुख शांति की हानि होती है।

entries.subcategory: Land Selection / Land Shape (भूमि के प्रकार)
entries.description: Land that is long in the east-west direction, elevated along the north-south axis, and low in the middle, is called Naag Prishtha Bhumi.
entries.recommendation: Avoid for construction.
entries.expected_effect: Causes anxiety/agitation (उद्वेग), fear of death (मृत्यु भय), suffering equivalent to death for wife/children, and increase of enemies.
entries.section: भूमि का चयन / भूमि के लक्षण
entries.source_text: पूर्व और पश्चिम दिशा में लंबी, उत्तर दक्षिण दिशा में ऊंची तथा बीचों-बीच जो भूमि नीची होती है उस भूमि को नाग पृष्ठ भूमि कहते हैं। ऐसी भूमि पर वास्तु निर्माण करने से उद्वेग, मृत्यु भय, स्त्री-पुत्रादि को मरण तुल्य कष्ट तथा शत्रु वृद्धि होती है।

entries.issue_topic: Natural slope toward east / north-east / north is favorable
entries.description: Vastusara states that if the natural water flow / slope of land is toward the east, north-east (ईशान) and north, that land brings great happiness, peace and prosperity to the family.
entries.recommendation: Prefer land/plots with a natural downward slope toward east, north-east, and north.
entries.expected_effect: Brings sukh-shanti (peace and happiness) and prosperity (समृद्धि) to the family; strengthens the family economically; residents remain healthy and vigorous.
entries.source_text: 'पुव्वेसाणुत्तरंबुवहा' अर्थात् पूर्व, ईशान एवं उत्तर की और जल प्रवाह हो तो वह भूमि परिवार के लिए अत्यंत सुख-शांति एवं समृद्धिदायक होती है। (वास्तुसार प्र.1)

entries.description: If the land slopes down toward the west, north-west (वायव्य) or south-west (नैऋत्य), it causes wasteful expenditure and financial difficulty.
entries.recommendation: Avoid such slopes; correct with fill/leveling if already present.
entries.remedy: Level land so downward slope faces east/north-east/north rather than west/south-west/north-west.
entries.expected_effect: Financial hardship (अर्थ संकट) due to purposeless/wasteful expenses.
entries.source_text: पश्चिम, वायव्य और नैऋत्य दिशा की ओर जमीन का उतार होने पर वह भूमि परिवार के लिए निष्प्रयोजन व्ययकारी होने से अर्थ संकट को प्रदान करती है।

entries.description: A slope toward south or south-east (आग्नेय) causes sudden loss of wealth, destruction of lineage, and death.
entries.recommendation: Avoid such slopes.
entries.expected_effect: Sudden loss of wealth (धन नाश), destruction of lineage (वंश नाश), destruction, death.
entries.source_text: दक्षिण, आग्नेय दिशा में उतार होने से अचानक धन नाश, वंश नाश, विनाश, मृत्यु की प्राप्ति होती है।

entries.description: A slope toward south-west (नैऋत्य) or north-west (वायव्य) causes the origination of many diseases in the family.
entries.recommendation: Avoid such slopes.
entries.expected_effect: Origination of many diseases (अनेकों रोगों की उत्पत्ति) in the family.
entries.source_text: नैऋत्य एवं वायव्य में उतार होने पर परिवार के लिए अनेकों रोगों की उत्पत्ति होती है।

entries.issue_topic: Depression (pit) at the centre of the land
entries.description: If there is a depression / pit at the centre of the land, it causes total destruction (सर्वनाश).
entries.recommendation: Avoid land with a central depression, or fill it before construction.
entries.remedy: Fill any central depression before building.
entries.expected_effect: Sarvanash — complete/total destruction for the household.
entries.source_text: भूमि के मध्य में गड्ढा होने पर सर्वनाश होता है।

entries.description: Dig a pit of 24 finger-widths (अंगुल) in length, width and depth at the centre of the proposed land, then refill it with the same excavated soil. If soil remains extra after refilling, the land is best (उत्तम); if it is exactly level, it is medium (मध्यम); if the soil falls short, the land is inferior (अधम).
entries.recommendation: Perform this soil-volume test before construction to grade land quality as उत्तम / मध्यम / अधम.
entries.expected_effect: Excess soil after refill = wealth, grain and prosperity for the owner. Level soil = no change in circumstances. Deficient soil = poverty and hardship for the owner.
entries.source_text: चउवीसंगुलभूमी खणेवि पूरिज्ज पुण वि सा गत्ता। तेणेव महियाए हीणाहि यसमफला णेया।। (वास्तुसार प्र.1 गाथा 3)

entries.description: Fill the same 24-अंगुल pit brim-full with water, walk 100 steps away and return. If the water level has dropped by three अंगुल, the land is inferior; if by two अंगुल, medium; if by only one अंगुल, the land is best.
entries.recommendation: Use this water-retention test to further verify land quality.
entries.expected_effect: One-अंगुल drop = best, brings happiness and contentment; two-अंगुल drop = medium; three-अंगुल drop = inferior, brings hardship to the family.
entries.source_text: अह सा भरिय जलेण य चरणसयं गच्छमाण जा सुसइ। वि-दु-इग अंगुल भूमि अहम मज्झम उत्तमा जाण।। (वास्तुसार प्र.1 गाथा 4)

entries.description: Dig a one-foot-deep pit, fill it with water, and inspect it the next morning (24 hours later). If some water remains, the land is best; if no water remains, it is medium; if the water has dried and cracks have appeared, it is inferior.
entries.recommendation: Use this overnight water-retention test as an additional land quality check.
entries.expected_effect: Water remaining = best land, abundant wealth and grain. No water = medium. Dried with cracks = inferior, brings poverty; livelihood becomes very difficult despite hard labor.
entries.source_text: भूमि में एक फुट नाप का गहरा गड्ढा खोदकर उसे जल से पूरा भर देवें। अगले दिन प्रात: उसका निरीक्षण करें।

entries.description: In the evening, place some flowers in the test pit and pour in a pot of water. If the flowers float, the land is excellent, auspicious and prosperity-giving. If the flowers sink and do not float, the land is inferior and inauspicious.
entries.recommendation: Use the floating-flower method as a quick evening land-quality test.
entries.remedy: Do not build any structure on land where the flowers sink.
entries.expected_effect: Floating flowers = auspicious, prosperity-giving land. Sinking flowers = inauspicious, sorrow-bringing land; construction should be avoided there.
entries.source_text: उपरोक्त गड्ढे में संध्या समय कुछ फूल डालें तथा ऊपर से उसमें एक घड़ा जल भर दें। यदि जल डालने पर फूल तैरने लगें तो भूमि उत्तम...समझना चाहिए।

entries.description: Plough the proposed land and sow various grains (sesame, barley, mustard, or all grains) across it. If sprouts appear within 3 nights, the land is excellent; within 5 nights, medium; within 7 nights, inferior and sorrow-bringing. Any portion where seeds do not sprout at all should be avoided entirely.
entries.recommendation: Test germination speed across the plot before building; discard any portion where seeds fail to sprout.
entries.expected_effect: 3-night sprouting = best land, brings happiness to the builder. 5-night = medium. 7-night = inferior and sorrowful for the builder.
entries.source_text: हलाकृष्टे तथोदेशे सर्व बीजानि वापयेत्। त्रि-पंच-सप्त रात्रेण न प्ररोहन्ति तान्यपि।। (विश्वकर्मा प्रकाश पृ. 10-11)

entries.description: At dusk, enclose a patch of ground with matting to block airflow, inscribe the astra-mantra 'ॐ हूं फट्' on the ground, place an unbaked clay pot and an unbaked clay lamp filled with ghee on it, with four wicks (white-east, red-south, yellow-west, black-north), consecrate the wicks with the Namokar Mahamantra, and light them. If the wicks burn until the ghee is exhausted, the land is auspicious; if they extinguish before the ghee is exhausted, the land is inauspicious and troublesome.
entries.recommendation: Perform this mantra-lamp ritual as a land-quality test prior to construction.
entries.mantra_spiritual_practice: The Namokar Mahamantra ('ॐ णमो अरिहंताणं, णमो सिद्धाणं, णमो आइरियाणं, णमो उवज्झायाणं, णमो लोए सव्व साहूणं...') followed by 'ह्रौं शांति कुरु कुरु स्वाहा।'
entries.expected_effect: Wicks burning till ghee exhausted = auspicious land. Wicks extinguishing early = inauspicious land, causes pain/trouble for the builder.
entries.source_text: प्रदोषे कंट संद्धतामिस्त्रियां च तद्भुवि। ऊँ हूँ फड़ित्यस्त्रमन्त्र... (प्रतिष्ठा विधि दर्पण पृ.4)

entries.description: Throw a handful of dust from the land forcefully into the air and observe its fall. If the dust falls downward, the land-owner's fortune will decline; if it stops mid-air, the owner stays stagnant without progress; if it rises upward, the owner will prosper.
entries.recommendation: Use as a simple field test of land fortune before construction begins.
entries.expected_effect: Dust falling down = decline; dust staying level = no progress; dust rising = prosperity.
entries.source_text: पांशवो रेणुतां नीत्वा, निरीक्षेदन्तरिक्षगाः। अधो मध्योर्ध्वगा: नृणां गति तुल्य फलप्रदाः।। (विश्वकर्मा प्रकाश पृ. 11)

entries.issue_topic: Ideal land qualities per Brihat Samhita
entries.description: Land praiseworthy for its medicinal plants and creepers, sweet-tasting, well-scented, smooth, free of pits and holes, and calming to travellers, is fit for construction.
entries.recommendation: Prefer land matching these qualities described in Brihat Samhita.
entries.expected_effect: Such land provides lasting prosperity (श्री) to those who build permanent dwellings on it.
entries.source_text: शस्तौषधि दुमलता मधुरा सुगन्धा स्निग्धा समान सुषिरा च मही नराणाम्। (वृहत्संहिता)

entries.description: Dig a small pit, remove some soil and smell it. A fried-food-like smell indicates excellent land. A grain-like smell is favorable for merchants/traders. A liquor or rotten smell indicates inferior land. A blood-like smell indicates land that produces cruelty of temperament in residents.
entries.recommendation: Test soil smell as part of land selection.
entries.expected_effect: Fried-food smell = happy, prosperous, healthy family. Grain smell = good for traders' wealth. Liquor/rotten smell = brings poverty. Blood smell = residents become fierce/aggressive by nature.
entries.source_text: जमीन में छोटा सा गढ़ा करके मिट्टी निकालकर उसे सूंघना चाहिए। यदि सूंघने पर तली हुई चीजों के समान बास आती है तो वह जमीन उत्तम है।

entries.description: East is called the Pitru Disha (ancestor/paternal direction). If the eastern open portion of the house is entirely closed off, the house becomes 'swami rahit' — the male head of the family passes away.
entries.recommendation: Keep the eastern side of the plot appropriately open, not fully blocked.
entries.expected_effect: Fully closing the east causes the demise of the principal male member of the family.
entries.source_text: पूर्व - पितृ दिशा है। मकान का पूर्वी खुला भाग पूरी तरह बंद देने पर मकान स्वामी रहित हो जाता है अर्थात् परिवार के पुरुष प्रधान सदस्य का अवसान हो जाता है।

entries.description: South-east is described as the health-giving (स्वास्थ्य प्रदाता) direction.
entries.expected_effect: Governs the health of residents.
entries.source_text: आग्नेय - स्वास्थ्य प्रदाता है।

entries.description: South governs prosperity, happiness and contentment — provided it is balanced and made 'heavier' (more built-up) relative to the other directions.
entries.recommendation: Make the south side of construction relatively heavier/more built-up in balance with other sides.
entries.expected_effect: Gives समृद्धि (prosperity), सुख (happiness) and संतोष (contentment) when balanced correctly.
entries.source_text: दक्षिण - समृद्धि, सुख तथा संतोषदायक है। (यदि अन्य दिशाओं के साथ संतुलन कर इसे भारी बनाया जाता है)

entries.description: South-west governs behaviour/temperament (व्यवहार, मनोभावना) and is responsible for untimely death (अकालमृत्यु) if mishandled.
entries.recommendation: Handle south-west construction with particular care given its link to untimely death.
entries.expected_effect: Affects the temperament of residents and can be responsible for untimely death.
entries.source_text: नैऋत्य - व्यवहार, मनोभावना तथा अकालमृत्यु के लिए उत्तरदायी है।

entries.description: West is the giver of progress, advancement and reputation/prestige.
entries.expected_effect: Gives प्रगति (progress), उत्कर्ष (advancement), प्रतिष्ठा (reputation/prestige).
entries.source_text: पश्चिम - प्रगति, उत्कर्ष तथा प्रतिष्ठा प्रदाता है।

entries.description: North-west regulates relationships with other people (सम्बन्धों का नियमन), governing cordiality and hospitality.
entries.expected_effect: Governs cordiality (हार्दिकता) and hospitality (आतिथ्य) in relationships with others.
entries.source_text: वायव्य - अन्य लोगों से सम्बन्धों का नियमन करता है जो हार्दिकता एवं आतिथ्य में निमित्त है।

entries.description: North is the Matru Disha (mother/maternal direction). If this space is left completely closed rather than open, the house becomes deserted because the female members of the family die and the household is left without women.
entries.recommendation: Keep the northern side of the plot appropriately open.
entries.expected_effect: Fully closing the north causes the death of female family members, leaving the household 'without women'.
entries.source_text: उत्तर - मातृ दिशा है। यह स्थान रिक्त न रखे जाने पर मकान निर्जन हो जाता है क्योंकि परिवार की महिला सदस्यों की मृत्यु हो जाने से परिवार बगैर स्त्रियों का हो जाता है।

entries.description: North-east ensures continuity of the male lineage. Cutting off / obstructing this direction in the house results in the family not having sons.
entries.recommendation: Keep the north-east corner of the plot uncut and unobstructed to support continuity of the male lineage.
entries.remedy: Avoid cutting the north-east corner of a plot/building.
entries.expected_effect: Cutting the north-east direction results in the family having no sons (पुत्र नहीं होते).
entries.source_text: ईशान - पुरुष वंश की निरंतरता को सुनिश्चित करता है। मकान में इस दिशा को काट देने से पुत्र नहीं होते।

entries.description: The four cardinal directions are fixed by the sunrise (east) and sunset (west) points, with north at a right angle to the left of sunrise and south at a right angle to the right. The four sub-directions (vidishas) lie between them: Ishan (NE) between north and east, Agneya (SE) between east and south, Nairritya (SW) between south and west, and Vayavya (NW) between west and north.
entries.recommendation: Use sunrise/sunset (or a magnetic compass, per later chapters) to establish accurate directional orientation before any Vastu planning.
entries.source_text: दिशाओं का निर्धारण सूर्योदय की दिशा के आधार से किया जाता है। सूर्योदय की दिशा पूर्व कहलाती है। सूर्यास्त की दिशा पश्चिम दिशा कही जाती है।

entries.description: The best direction for the kitchen (रसोईघर/चौका) is south-east (आग्नेय), which is associated with the fire element (अग्नि तत्व). Fire is understood to burn away/consume inauspicious happenings; placing the kitchen in the south-east is said to burn away household troubles.
entries.recommendation: Build the kitchen in the south-east (Agneya) portion of the house, in line with Vastu-compliant directions so that the tradition of offering food to monks (मुनि दान) can be properly maintained.
entries.expected_effect: Placing the kitchen correctly in the south-east helps 'burn away' (destroy) household troubles/calamities.
entries.source_text: रसोई घर के लिए सर्वश्रेष्ठ दिशा आग्नेय मानी गई है। आग्नेय दिशा में अग्नि तत्व माना जाता है... नियमित रूपेण अग्नि या रसोई घर को आग्नेय दिशा में रखने से घर की सभी आपत्तियां भस्म होती हैं।

entries.issue_topic: Facing direction and layout while cooking
entries.description: While cooking, women should face east, which is said to be health-promoting. The stove/hearth should not be visible from the main outside door. Kitchen equipment (grinder, mixer, khal-batta, okhli) should be kept within the kitchen itself. Idle or vulgar conversation in the kitchen pollutes its environment.
entries.recommendation: Orient the cook to face east; screen the stove from the entrance door's line of sight; store kitchen equipment within the kitchen; avoid idle/vulgar talk in the kitchen.
entries.expected_effect: Facing east while cooking is health-promoting (आरोग्य वर्धक). A visible stove from the entrance risks full loss/harm (पूर्ण हानि) to the family. Proper equipment placement brings contentment; polluting talk pollutes the kitchen's atmosphere.
entries.source_text: रसोई बनाते समय स्त्रियों का मुख पूर्व की ओर होना चाहिए। यह आरोग्य वर्धक है। बाहर के द्वार से चूल्हा नहीं दिखना चाहिए। ऐसा होने पर परिवार को पूर्ण हानि होने की संभावना है।

entries.issue_topic: Kitchen placed in Ishan (North-East) for plots with north/east-facing roads
entries.description: For plots with roads on the north and east sides, placing the kitchen (पाकशाला) in the north-east (Ishan) causes household discord and financial loss.
entries.recommendation: Avoid placing the kitchen in the Ishan (north-east) corner, especially on plots with north- and east-facing roads.
entries.remedy: Relocate the kitchen away from the Ishan corner.
entries.expected_effect: Causes family discord (पारिवारिक कलह) and financial loss/suffering (धन हानि का संताप).
entries.source_text: ऐसे भूखण्ड जिनमें उत्तर एवं पूर्व में सड़क हैं, उनमें ईशान में पाकशाला (रसोई घर) बनाने से पारिवारिक कलह तथा धन हानि का संताप भोगना पड़ता है।

entries.issue_topic: Ancient room-placement scheme cited from Umasvami Shravakachar (verses 112-113)
entries.description: According to the classical Jain text Umasvami Shravakachar (verses 112 and 113), the śrī-griha (treasury/wealth room) belongs in the east, the kitchen in the south-east, the bedroom in the south, and the weapon-store plus delivery/maternity room in the south-west.
entries.recommendation: Historic reference scheme: śrī-griha (treasury) → East; kitchen → South-East; bedroom → South; weapon room and maternity room → South-West.
entries.chapter: Khand VIII (कक्ष एवं स्थान) — introductory note
entries.source_text: इनके अनुसार पूर्व में श्रीगृह, आग्नेय में रसोईघर, दक्षिण में शयनकक्ष, नैऋत्य में शस्त्र गृह तथा प्रसूतिगृह...

entries.issue_topic: Recommended placement for main door, dining room, treasury and shrine
entries.description: The main entrance of the building is best placed facing east. The kitchen is best in the south-east. The dining room should be in the west. The treasury/storeroom (धनागार) should be in the north. The household shrine (चैत्यालय / देवस्थान) should be built in the north-east (Ishan).
entries.recommendation: Main door → East (best); Kitchen → South-East; Dining room → West; Treasury → North; Household shrine → North-East (Ishan). Avoid crooked, hexagonal, or triangular courtyard shapes.
entries.source_text: वास्तु का मुख्य द्वार पूर्व में रखना सर्वश्रेष्ठ है। रसोईघर आग्नेय दिशा में रखना सर्वोत्तम है। भोजन कक्ष पश्चिम में रखें। धनागार उत्तर दिशा में रखें। चैत्यालय अथवा देवस्थान ईशान में बनाएं। आंगन टेढ़ा-मेढ़ा अथवा षट्कोण, त्रिकोण न बनाएं।

entries.subcategory: Reasons a house becomes difficult to sell
entries.issue_topic: Financial/family trouble caused by defects in the Ishan (north-east) corner
entries.description: Financial and family difficulties leading owners to sell their homes can be traced to Vastu faults such as: a weakened wall in the north-east, a toilet or kitchen located in the north-east, the north-east portion being the highest part of the building, or the north-east corner being cut off.
entries.recommendation: Check and correct any of these Ishan-corner faults if a household is experiencing financial or family trouble.
entries.remedy: Correct these specific Ishan-corner faults (strengthen the wall, relocate the toilet/kitchen away from Ishan, lower the height of the Ishan portion, restore any cut corner) to relieve the associated difficulties.
entries.expected_effect: Correcting these Ishan-corner faults is said to bring relief (मुक्ति) from the associated troubles.
entries.section: क्रय-विक्रय) / तैयार वास्तु का क्रय विचार
entries.source_text: मसलन वास्तु की ईशान दिशा की दीवाल कमजोर हो गई हो अथवा ईशान दिशा में शौचालय या रसोईघर हो। ईशान दिशा में सबसे ऊंचा भाग हो या ईशान दिशा का भाग कटा हो तो वास्तु बिकने के प्रसंग आ जाते हैं। यदि उपरोक्त वास्तु दोषों को सुधार लिया जाए तो परेशानियों से मुक्ति मिल जाती है।

entries.subcategory: Vedh Dosha (वेध दोष) — 7 types of obstruction defects
entries.description: 'Vedh' means an obstruction/blockage. A Vedh defect occurs when there is something obstructing the main entrance — such as a path, another door, a well, a tree, or a pillar — directly in front of it, or when a structural element is not built to the proper proportion/measure in its proper place. Seven types of Vedh are named.
entries.recommendation: Ensure nothing obstructs the main entrance and that all structural proportions follow prescribed measurements.
entries.source_text: वेध का आशय बाधा से है... मुख्य प्रवेशद्वार के समक्ष किसी मार्ग, द्वार, कूप, वृक्ष, स्तंभ आदि का होना अथवा यथोचित स्थान पर परिमाण सहित न होना वेध कहा जाता है। वेध ये हैं- 1. तल वेध 2. कोण वेध 3. तालू वेध 4. कपाल वेध 5. स्तंभ वेध 6. तुला वेध 7. द्वार वेध (वास्तुसार प्र.1 गा.116)

entries.subcategory: Vedh Dosha — Tala Vedh (तल वेध / floor-level defect)
entries.issue_topic: Tala Vedh: uneven floor / obstruction in front of door
entries.description: Occurs when the plot's ground level is uneven (partly level, partly uneven), or when a well, oil-press, water wheel, or sugarcane-juice extractor is located directly in front of the door, or when a path to a well or another person's house passes through one's own property.
entries.recommendation: Avoid uneven ground levels and keep the front of the main door clear of wells, machinery, or through-paths belonging to others.
entries.expected_effect: Causes disease, leucoderma (white-patch disease), skin diseases, leprosy and similar illnesses.
entries.source_text: वास्तु की भूमि कहीं सम कहीं विषम हो अथवा द्वार के सामने कुंआ हो... तो वह तलवेध कहलाता है। ऐसा होने से घर में रोग, सफेददाग की बीमारी, चर्मरोग, कुष्ठरोग, आदि रोगों का आगमन होता है।

entries.subcategory: Vedh Dosha — Kona Vedh (कोण वेध / corner-angle defect)
entries.issue_topic: Kona Vedh: house corners not at true right angles
entries.description: Occurs when the corners of the house are not exactly 90 degrees — either more or less.
entries.recommendation: Ensure all corners of the building are true 90-degree right angles.
entries.expected_effect: Causes inauspicious events, troubles, and risk of vehicle accidents among family residents.
entries.source_text: घर के कोने यदि समकोण 90 अंश के समान न होकर कम ज्यादा हों तो कोण वेध होता है। घर के निवासी परिवारजनों में अशुभ घटना, परेशानियां, वाहन दुर्घटना आदि की आशंका रहती है।

entries.issue_topic: Talu Vedh: uneven floor heights within one section
entries.description: Occurs when floor levels are uneven (higher/lower) within a single section of a building.
entries.recommendation: Keep floor levels consistent within each section of a building.
entries.expected_effect: Creates a fear/risk of theft (चोरी का भय) in the household.
entries.source_text: एक ही खंड में पीढ़े ऊंचे-नीचे होने पर तालुवेध होता है। इससे चोरी का भय होता है।

entries.subcategory: Vedh Dosha — Shir Vedh (शिर वेध / kapal vedh)
entries.issue_topic: Shir Vedh: a joint/break at the centre of the door lintel
entries.description: Occurs when there is a joint or seam (गर्भ / पोढ़ा) at the exact middle of the beam/lintel above the door.
entries.recommendation: Ensure the lintel above the main door is a single unbroken piece, with no joint at its exact centre.
entries.expected_effect: Causes poverty (दरिद्रता) as well as physical and mental distress (शारीरिक, मानसिक क्लेश).
entries.source_text: द्वार के ऊपर की पटरी पर गर्भ यानी मध्य भाग में पोढ़ा आये तो शिर वेध होता है। इससे घर में दरिद्रता तथा शारीरिक, मानसिक क्लेश होता है।

entries.subcategory: Vedh Dosha — Stambh Vedh (स्तम्भ वेध / हृदय शल्य)
entries.issue_topic: Stambh Vedh: pillar or fire/water element at the centre of the house
entries.description: Occurs when there is a pillar at the centre of the house, or when a fire installation or water body/tank is located at the centre of the house — also called 'hriday shalya' (heart-thorn defect).
entries.recommendation: Keep the exact centre of the house (Brahmasthan) free of pillars, fire installations, and water bodies.
entries.remedy: Remove or relocate any pillar, fire source, or water feature from the exact centre of the house.
entries.expected_effect: Risk of destruction of lineage and decline/extinction of the family line (वंशनाश, कुल क्षय की संभावना).
entries.source_text: घर के मध्य भाग में स्तम्भ हो या घर के मध्य भाग में अग्नि या जल का स्थान हो तो घर में स्तम्भ वेध या हृदय शल्य होता है। इससे वंशनाश, कुल क्षय की संभावना रहती है।

entries.issue_topic: Tula Vedh: mismatched number of stairs/steps between floors
entries.description: Occurs when the number of steps in the staircases of the upper and lower floors of a building differ. If the number of steps is equal on both floors, there is no defect.
entries.recommendation: Ensure the number of stairs/steps is identical between the upper and lower floors.
entries.expected_effect: Leads to inauspicious/unfortunate events in the household.
entries.source_text: घर के ऊपर-नीचे की मंजिल में पीढ़े कम ज्यादा हों तो तुला वेध होता है। यदि पीढ़े समान संख्या में हैं तो दोष नहीं रहता है। इससे घर में अशुभ फलदायक घटनाएं होती हैं।

entries.subcategory: Vedh Dosha — Dwar Vedh (द्वार वेध / entrance obstruction)
entries.issue_topic: Dwar Vedh: obstructions directly facing the main door
entries.description: Occurs when a tree, well, pillar, another house's corner, an animal-tethering post, stagnant mud, animals like pigs, another's pathway, a drainage channel, or a Brahma-temple door faces directly opposite one's own main door.
entries.recommendation: Keep the space directly opposite the main door free of trees, wells, pillars, others' building corners, tethering posts, stagnant mud, animals, through-paths, drains, or temples facing the door.
entries.expected_effect: Overall destructive/inauspicious outcomes for the household, varying with the specific obstruction (see related remedy entries for effects of each type).
entries.source_text: घर के द्वार के सामने या मध्य में कोई वृक्ष, कुंआ, स्तम्भ हो अथवा किसी के मकान का कोना अपने घर के सामने हो या गाय आदि पशु बांधने का खूटा गाड़ा गया हो तो द्वार वेध होता है।

entries.subcategory: Vedh Dosha — cumulative effect of multiple defects
entries.issue_topic: Compounding severity of multiple simultaneous Vedh defects in one house
entries.description: If a house is affected by one Vedh defect, there is domestic discord (कलह). With two, there is major financial loss. With three, the house becomes haunted by spirits (भूतों का वास). With four, wealth/Lakshmi is destroyed. With five, there is an epidemic/severe affliction (महामारी).
entries.recommendation: Address any Vedh defects promptly; the severity of consequences compounds with the number of simultaneous defects present.
entries.expected_effect: 1 defect = discord; 2 = major loss; 3 = haunting; 4 = destruction of wealth; 5 = epidemic/severe affliction.
entries.source_text: इगवेहेण य कलहो कमेण हाणि च जत्थ दो ति। तिहु भूआण निवासो चउहि खओ पंचहिं मारी।। (वास्तुसार प्र.1 गा.124)

entries.issue_topic: Remedy: intervening road or wall neutralises Vedh defect
entries.description: If a public road, boundary wall, or fort/rampart lies between a temple and a house, no Vedh defect arises. If there is a wall in between, the pillar-base Vedh defect is also nullified.
entries.recommendation: When an obstruction (e.g., temple, pillar) faces the main door but a road or wall genuinely intervenes between the two, the Vedh defect is considered neutralised.
entries.remedy: Ensure a road, boundary wall or rampart genuinely separates the house from the obstructing structure to neutralise the defect.
entries.expected_effect: Neutralises (removes) the Vedh defect that would otherwise apply.
entries.source_text: राजमार्गान्तरे वेधो न प्राकारन्तरेऽपि च। स्तंभ पदादि वेधस्तु नाभित्यंतरतो भवेत्।। देवालय और मकान के मध्य यदि राजमार्ग, कोट, किला आदि आयें तो वेध दोष नहीं होता।

entries.issue_topic: Remedy: sufficient distance neutralises Vedh defect (per Achar Dinkar)
entries.description: If the distance to the obstruction is at least twice the height of the house (or four times the height in the case of a temple), any Vedh-type defect is not counted as applicable.
entries.recommendation: When evaluating whether an obstruction constitutes a Vedh defect, first check whether it lies beyond twice the house's height (or four times a temple's height) — if so, no defect applies.
entries.remedy: Increase the distance between the building and the obstruction to at least the prescribed multiple of height, where feasible.
entries.expected_effect: Beyond the prescribed distance, the Vedh defect does not apply / is not counted.
entries.source_text: उच्छ्रायभूमि द्विगुणां त्यक्त्वा चैत्ये चतुर्गुणाम्। वेधादि दोषो नैवं स्याद् एवं त्वष्टमतं यथा।। (आचार दिनकर)

entries.subcategory: Dwar Vedh — specific obstruction effects (Nardi Samhita)
entries.issue_topic: Specific effects of different objects obstructing the main door (per Nardi Samhita)
entries.description: Per Nardi Samhita: a path to another's house through one's own main door is destructive; a tree obstruction in front of the main door harms children; stagnant mud in front causes grief; a drainage channel in front destroys wealth; a Shiva or Sun temple facing the main door destroys the house-owner; a pillar in front is harmful to women; a well in front causes epilepsy/vayu disorders (अपस्मार); a Brahma-temple door facing one's own destroys the family lineage.
entries.recommendation: Keep the space facing the main door completely clear of the above specific obstructions; if any Sun/Shiva temple faces the main door, reorient or shield the entrance.
entries.expected_effect: Varies by obstruction: destruction (path), harm to children (tree), grief (mud), loss of wealth (drain), destruction of owner (temple facing door), harm to women (pillar), epilepsy/vayu disorder (well), destruction of lineage (Brahma-temple door).
entries.source_text: रथ्यांविद्धं द्वारं नाशाय कुमारदोपदं तरुणा। पंकद्वारे शोको व्ययोऽम्बुनि: स्त्राविणि प्रोक्तः।। कूपेनापस्मारो भवति विनाशश्च देवताविद्धे। (नारदी संहिता)

entries.issue_topic: Odd (three) pillars in a hall/house are inauspicious
entries.description: Wells/water-halls, pavilions and houses should not have three pillars. Pillars should always be in an even number; an odd number of pillars causes the builder/craftsman to fall into ruin and the owner's wealth to be entirely destroyed.
entries.recommendation: Always build with an even number of pillars; never use exactly three.
entries.expected_effect: Odd number of pillars → craftsman ruined (शिल्पी भरक जाता है), owner becomes distressed and loses all wealth.
entries.source_text: वापी मण्डप गेहानां तृतीय स्तम्भ वर्जनम्। शिल्पिनो नरकं यान्ति, स्वामी सर्वधन क्षयम्।।

entries.issue_topic: Effects of the number of corners in a house
entries.description: A house with two corners causes loss of wealth; a Gomukh-shaped (funnel-shaped) house forces the head of household into exile/migration abroad; a triangular (three-cornered) house causes death or death-like suffering; a hexagonal (six-cornered) house destroys dharma (religious practice).
entries.recommendation: Avoid two-cornered, gomukh-shaped, triangular, or hexagonal building/plot shapes.
entries.expected_effect: Two corners → wealth loss; Gomukh shape → forced migration; triangular → death/death-like suffering; hexagonal → destruction of dharma.
entries.source_text: द्विकोणं गोमुखाश्चैव धननाशः पतिव्रजः। त्रिकोणं मृत्युदं ज्ञेयं षड्शं धर्म नाशकम्।।

entries.issue_topic: Requirement to perform Vastu Shanti before occupying a new construction
entries.description: When any new building or new temple is constructed, or a pond, well, or borewell is dug, or a shop, factory, school, hospital or other structure is built, a Vastu Shanti ritual (वास्तु शान्ति विधान) must be performed for it.
entries.recommendation: Perform a Vastu Shanti ritual before occupying or using any newly constructed building, water body, or well.
entries.source_text: जब किसी नवीन वास्तु का निर्माण कराया जाता है अथवा नया मन्दिर निर्मित किया जाता है तो उसके निमित्त वास्तु शान्ति विधान अवश्य ही किया जाना चाहिए।

entries.subcategory: Vastu Puja (वास्तु पूजन) — scale by structure type
entries.issue_topic: Which Vastu-chakra (grid) size to use for which type of structure
entries.description: A 64-cell (चौंसठ पद) Vastu chakra is used for villages, royal palaces and towns; an 81-cell (इक्यासी पद) chakra for ordinary houses; a 49-cell (उनचास पद) chakra for renovations; a 100-cell (सौ पद) chakra for temples and mandapas; and a 196-cell (एक सौ छियानवे पद) chakra for wells, stepwells, ponds and forests/gardens.
entries.recommendation: Select the Vastu-chakra grid size according to the type of structure: 64-cell for villages/palaces/towns; 81-cell for houses; 49-cell for renovations; 100-cell for temples/mandapas; 196-cell for wells/tanks/ponds/gardens.
entries.source_text: गांव, राजमहल, नगर में चौंसठ पद का वास्तु चक्र पूजन करना चाहिए। सभी प्रकार के घरों में इक्यासी पद का, जीर्णोद्धार में उनचास पद का, समस्त देवालयों तथा मंडप में सौ पद का तथा कुंए, बावड़ी, तालाब एवं वन में एक सौ छियानवे पद का वास्तु पूजन करना चाहिए।

entries.issue_topic: Procedure for performing the Vastu Vidhan ritual
entries.description: The Indra/Indrani and the presiding ritual-acharya bathe and wear clean garments (dhoti-dupatta), perform irya-path-shuddhi (purification of movement) at the temple and pay respects to the Jina image. The Jina idol is carried to the ritual site, placed on a decorated pedestal/vedi; sacred designs (mandala) are drawn; Indra-Indrani sakalikaran, Indra pratishtha, and mandap-shuddhi are performed; then a panchamrit abhishek (five-nectar consecratory bath) is offered before all present worship the Deva-Shastra-Guru trinity, offer arghya, and begin the main ritual, ending with a visarjan (closing) and homa (fire offering).
entries.recommendation: Follow this sequence for a formal Vastu Vidhan ritual: purification bath and clean dress → irya-path-shuddhi and darshan → mandala drawing → sakalikaran/pratishtha/mandap-shuddhi → panchamrit abhishek → Deva-Shastra-Guru puja and arghya → main vidhan → visarjan and homa.
entries.mantra_spiritual_practice: The overall Vastu Vidhan ritual sequence itself (sakalikaran, panchamrit abhishek, Deva-Shastra-Guru puja, arghya, homa).
entries.source_text: इन्द्राणी व प्रतिष्ठाचार्य स्नानादिक से निवृत्त हो शुद्ध वस्त्र (धोती-दुपट्टा) पहनें, मन्दिर में इर्यापथ शुद्धि करके भगवान के दर्शन करें...

entries.description: For Vastu Puja, a Vastu-mandal with 76 squares (कोठे) should be prepared for the 49 Vastu deities, and each deity's designated food offering (नैवेद्य) should be placed in a separate offering vessel as specified.
entries.recommendation: Prepare a 76-square Vastu mandal for the 49 Vastu deities and offer each deity's specified naivedya (food offering) separately.
entries.source_text: ऊपर लिखे अनुसार वास्तु पूजन के लिए 49 वास्तु देवताओं के वास्तु मंडल में 76 कोठे बनाना चाहिए।

entries.issue_topic: Use of the Namokar Mahamantra in Vastu land-testing ritual
entries.description: The Namokar Mahamantra is recited to consecrate the four wicks of a clay lamp used in the mantra-lamp land test (see Land Testing Test 6), followed by the phrase 'ह्रौं शांति कुरु कुरु स्वाहा' (invoking peace).
entries.recommendation: Recite the Namokar Mahamantra when consecrating ritual items such as lamp wicks in Vastu-related rites.
entries.mantra_spiritual_practice: ॐ णमो अरिहंताणं, णमो सिद्धाणं, णमो आइरियाणं, णमो उवज्झायाणं, णमो लोए सव्व साहूणं। ... ह्रौं शांति कुरु कुरु स्वाहा।।
entries.expected_effect: Recitation of this mantra is believed to sanctify/empower the ritual items (here, the lamp wicks) used in testing land auspiciousness.
entries.source_text: ॐ णमो अरिहंताणं, णमो सिद्धाणं, णमो आइरियाणं, णमो उवज्झायाणं, णमो लोए सव्व साहूणं।

entries.subcategory: Prohibition on entering an unconsecrated house
entries.issue_topic: House must have Vastu Puja performed before occupancy
entries.description: One should not move into / reside in a house that lacks a roof or proper doors/door-frames installed, or in which Vastu Puja has not been performed.
entries.recommendation: Do not enter or occupy a newly built house until it has a completed roof, installed doors, and a properly performed Vastu Puja.
entries.expected_effect: Residing in such an incomplete/unconsecrated house is described as unsuitable (उपयुक्त नहीं).
entries.source_text: जिस घर में छत या छप्पर न हो, चौखट या दरवाजे स्थापित न किए हों तथा वास्तु पूजन न किया गया हो, उस घर में प्रवेश नहीं करना चाहिए। उस घर में वास करना उपयुक्त नहीं है।
